description: List the profiles in this Espaço. Call it first: every other tool that takes `profile` wants one of these. A profile with `hasInstagram: true` is an Instagram account and its `profile` is the @: posts and on-brand images are made for those. One with `hasInstagram: false` is a brand with no Instagram: its `profile` is only a name for it in SmartGenius, never an @. `blog` is the profile's blog (or null while it has none). Each profile is a brand, and a brand can post to more than one Instagram account or blog: list_brands lists them.
name: list_profiles
title: List profiles
